instruction: A candid documentary photograph, medium full shot, inside a judo dojo with yellow and blue mats. The young woman in the blue judogi (R1) stands in the center, looking down at her partner with her hands slightly raised. In the foreground, the young man in the white judogi (R2) is kneeling and bowing deeply, his head lowered close to the mat. The background features a plain wall with a notice board. The scene is lit by bright, natural indoor light, creating a clean and focused atmosphere.
